title: Minesouls - spawn eggs
description: This resourcepack change the vanilla eggs textures for mobs.
body:
![Minesouls banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3d9a588580ff40f6168bd6e7c9715aaf7250f4fe.png)

This resourcepack change the vanilla eggs textures for mobs.

New texture is a soul flame like item, animated.Some textures seems really good, but others not so much for the original colors of the mobs.

I will release a new version onece 1.21.5 is out
